whenToUse: Long pages people skim downward, such as introductions or product lists.
You lightly signal that the section changed.
Effects that play once and are done.
whenNotToUse: App screens used often (people wait every time).
Content that must be read right away, such as search results.
Large effects that keep changing with the scroll position.

alternatives.name: Stagger
alternatives.reason: Showing several items in turn at once.

accessibility: Without the observer, content shows from the start so nothing stays hidden.
Once shown, it doesn't hide again.
With reduced motion, only opacity changes, without movement or zooming.
The scroll area has a tabIndex and a name, so it can be scrolled with the keyboard.
